candidate.name: Higgsfield MCP
candidate.license: Proprietary hosted service, credit-metered, free tier 150 credits/month
permissions: Send shot descriptions and prompts to Higgsfield
Spend Higgsfield account credits on every generate_* call
Read generated media URLs and status
secret_requirements: OAuth login to a Higgsfield account via /mcp; no API key stored in the repo
candidate.overlap: Image and video generation for hero clips and ad footage. HeyGen HyperFrames (connected, no credit cost) covers code-driven motion; use it first. LandingFolio covers layout reference only. Brand truth stays in the site-factory harvest.
candidate.rollback: Delete the higgsfield block from .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json and revoke the OAuth grant in the Higgsfield account. No vault content depends on the server.

source_review.evidence: Vendor-hosted endpoint documented by techsy.io and wrapped by robonuggets/higgsfield-skill (CC BY 4.0). Closed source; accepted on a narrow generate/status surface.

inspector.evidence: Endpoint requires OAuth; tools listed from vendor documentation, not enumerated live. Run /mcp on the Windows box after login to confirm the five tool names.

permission_review.evidence: No filesystem, messaging, deployment, or account-mutation permission. Every generate_* call is external spend and is approval-gated in System/approval-queue.md.

prompt_injection.evidence: Generated media, captions, and URLs are untrusted third-party content. Handling rule recorded in 12_Brain/02_Entities/Higgsfield MCP.md; never put client names or harvested facts in prompts.

overlap_review.evidence: Bounded to footage generation. HyperFrames remains first choice for code-driven motion at zero credit cost.

findings.detail: Every generation consumes credits; free tier is two or three clips per month.
